title: Appeal Level and Filer: Units Added to an Overturn Authorization
content:
The path an appeal took under the Member Appeals Program adds units to the overturn ceiling of the authorization owed after a quantity limit denial on an acute migraine drug is overturned under the Utilization Management Program.

**Rule.** An overturn at the second level or by external review adds 2 units; a first-level overturn of an appeal filed by the prescriber adds 1 unit; a first-level overturn of an appeal filed by the member or a representative adds nothing.

| Level at which the appeal was overturned | Appeal filed by | Units |
|---|---|---|
| second level | anyone | 2 |
| external review | anyone | 2 |
| first level | the prescriber | 1 |
| first level | the member or a representative | 0 |

The level read is that of the member's most recent overturned appeal of a coverage review denial; the filer is whoever filed the appeal on the denied request.
